column1: # Requirements proven by review, not by a test: the requirement, a tab, how it is verified.

column2: CI job check (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs bun run check (tsc 7, tsconfig.json), bun run lint (Bun lint, type-aware, max-warnings 0, IFC TypeScript plugin) and bun run fmt:check on every push and pull request.

CI job check runs bun run test:ci (ifc test on Bun and Node 26, every report, the ledger) and uploads the record; job suite runs bun run test on macOS and Windows; tools/test.ts fails the run on a requirement neither proven nor reviewed.
